ready.description: True only when no check failed, the artifact builds clean, and the venue's hard requirements are met. A paper with an honest limitation is ready; a paper with an unchecked hard requirement is not.

blocking_reason.description: Why ready is false. Required in practice when it is.

clean.description: True when the build was made from scratch, not incrementally.

observed.description: The evidence the status rests on. A pass without evidence is not a pass.

requirement.description: What the venue asked for, when the check compares against a requirement.

unresolved.description: Everything still open, carried forward from the final revision without softening.

needs.description: What it would take to close this.

placeholders.description: What the paper is still missing, counted rather than softened. This is the field that keeps 'not yet measured' from being indistinguishable from 'measured and small': the paper may legitimately ship with sites its author has not filled, but it may not claim to be ready while it does.

open.description: Placeholders still open at finalization, each with the source that would close it.

source.description: What would fill it. Carried into the submission checklist so the gap is actionable.

filled.description: How many registered placeholders now carry a value and a source.

blocking_ready.description: True when open is non-empty. Recorded so the run states the consequence itself instead of leaving it to the reader.

summary.description: What the paper establishes, in the words the evidence supports.

x-piano-assertions.message: ready must be false while placeholders.blocking_ready is true: the manuscript still shows \ph{} sites the author has not measured, so this is not a submittable version of the paper. Shipping it as ready would present an unmeasured slot as a result.

example.blocking_reason: Table 3 still compares against a baseline tuned for a different shape set; the venue counts this as an evaluation defect, and the fix needs a re-run.

checks.name: page_limit
checks.observed: Built PDF is 10 pages including references.

checks.name: template
checks.observed: \documentclass[sigconf]{acmart} with the venue's option set, geometry unchanged.

checks.name: anonymized
checks.observed: Searched sources and the PDF for author names, the group's domain, and the repository URL: no matches.

checks.name: figures
checks.observed: 6 figures resolved; 1 was re-exported at 300dpi after it rendered soft at print size.

checks.name: appendix
checks.observed: The venue's artifact-appendix requirement was not confirmed; the call's artifact policy was not in the brief.

unresolved.item: Table 3's baseline is not shape-matched, so the 1.3x gap is not attributable to the design.
unresolved.needs: A baseline run over the round's shape set.

unresolved.item: The abstract's scope was narrowed to sparse GEMM rather than evaluated on dense.
unresolved.needs: Dense shapes in the evaluation, or the narrowing stands.

unresolved.item: No comparison against the fused vendor kernel reviewers will expect.
unresolved.needs: One fused-kernel baseline over the evaluated shapes.

unresolved.item: Whether to submit before the artifact-appendix question is resolved.

open.source: an eval workload that starts the run from a production kernel rather than the naive baseline; the from-scratch arm it would be compared against is already measured

example.summary: The paper shows that a single operator grammar reaches within 8% of hand-tuned kernels on the six sparse shapes evaluated, at 1.58x over the released baseline, with the dense claim deferred.
